description: Full render request example — includes watermark, barcode, and qrcode configs

notes.composite_template: This template is COMPOSITE. AssemblyEngineService renders segments in spec/assembly-config.json order and merges outputs.
notes.conditional_segments: Part H (Security) and Part I (Guarantee) are conditional segments controlled by has_security and has_guarantor.
notes.data_scope: Some segments define dataScope to only expose the minimum required fields.
notes.derived_parameters: total_facility_amount, total_fee_amount, weighted_avg_rate, total_security_value, overall_ltv are DERIVED parameters computed by the expression engine.
notes.aggregations: facilities.$sum_amount, facilities.$avg_interest_rate, fees.$sum_amount are injected by AggregationResolver.
